references.text: God's promise to Abraham to give his descendants the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates, with a list of the peoples living there, including several of the same nations mentioned in Deuteronomy 7:1.
God tells Moses that He will lead the Israelites to a land flowing with milk and honey, where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites live.
God's angel shall go before Israel and lead them to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, whom God will destroy.
God promises to send an angel ahead of Israel and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
God promises to drive out the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites before Israel.
Joshua tells that the living God will drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
Joshua reminds the people how God gave them victory over the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Nehemiah recalls that God found Abraham's heart faithful and made a covenant to give the land to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites, and Girgashites.
Paul refers to how God destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave the land to Israel as an inheritance.
